cases.name: a .sh Claude writes in the workshop gets its executable bit, silently
cases.cmd: h={{CLAUDE}}/hooks/make-executable.sh; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-mkexec-{{SID}}-XXXXXX"); mkdir -p "$d/teams/alpha" "$d/workbooks/alpha/runs/RUN-1"; pay() { printf '{"tool_name":"%s","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s"},"cwd":"%s"}' "$1" "$2" "$d"; }; run() { pay "$1" "$2" | ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$d bash "$h"; }; xb() { printf '%s' $(( (8#$(stat -c %a "$1") & 8#111) != 0 )); }; mk() { printf "$2" > "$1"; chmod 644 "$1"; }; mk $d/teams/alpha/tool.sh '#!/bin/bash\necho hi\n'; o=$(run Write $d/teams/alpha/tool.sh); rc=$?; printf 'x=%s out=%s rc=%s' "$(xb $d/teams/alpha/tool.sh)" "${#o}" "$rc"; rm -rf "$d"

cases.name: a .sh written in CRLF gets the bit and is said through additionalContext, its bytes unchanged
cases.cmd: h={{CLAUDE}}/hooks/make-executable.sh; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-mkexec-{{SID}}-XXXXXX"); mkdir -p "$d/teams/alpha" "$d/workbooks/alpha/runs/RUN-1"; pay() { printf '{"tool_name":"%s","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s"},"cwd":"%s"}' "$1" "$2" "$d"; }; run() { pay "$1" "$2" | ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$d bash "$h"; }; xb() { printf '%s' $(( (8#$(stat -c %a "$1") & 8#111) != 0 )); }; mk() { printf "$2" > "$1"; chmod 644 "$1"; }; mk $d/teams/alpha/crlf.sh '#!/bin/bash\r\necho hi\r\n'; o=$(run Write $d/teams/alpha/crlf.sh); printf 'x=%s cr=%s ctx=%s event=%s' "$(xb $d/teams/alpha/crlf.sh)" "$(grep -c $'\r' $d/teams/alpha/crlf.sh)" "$(printf '%s' "$o" | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext' | grep -c '^make-executable: .*CRLF')" "$(printf '%s' "$o" | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName')"; rm -rf "$d"

cases.cmd:
h={{CLAUDE}}/hooks/make-executable.sh; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-mkexec-{{SID}}-XXXXXX"); mkdir -p "$d/teams/alpha" "$d/workbooks/alpha/runs/RUN-1"; pay() { printf '{"tool_name":"%s","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s"},"cwd":"%s"}' "$1" "$2" "$d"; }; run() { pay "$1" "$2" | ORKEON_WORKSHOP=$d bash "$h"; }; xb() { printf '%s' $(( (8#$(stat -c %a "$1") & 8#111) != 0 )); }; mk() { printf "$2" > "$1"; chmod 644 "$1"; }; mk $d/teams/alpha/off.sh '#!/bin/bash
